text: Conclusion & Future Work Key Contributions = Introduced Transformer, first attention-only transduction model = Eliminated recurrence/convolution - better parallelization = Set new SOTA in machine translation with lower training cost = Generalizes to other tasks (e.g., constituency parsing) Future Work = Apply to other modalities (images, audio) = Explore local attention for large sequences = Improve generation sequentiality = Enhance attention interpretability Code: https://github.com/tensorflow/tensor2tensor
